subject: Planning a community repair visit
text: Hello, I am finalizing the site visit for the community repair workshop and wanted to confirm the timeline before sending the invitation to volunteers. I initially proposed next Tuesday at two o'clock, but I now have an unexpected conflict that runs from one thirty until three fifteen. Could we move the start to three thirty? I can arrive twenty minutes early to check lighting, extension cords, signage, and the folding tables in the back room. If the technician needs access to the equipment closet before the group arrives, that window should still be available. Please let me know whether the shift creates any staffing problems for the maintenance team. Also, if the entrance sign is still damaged, I can bring a temporary paper one from the office. I assume parking passes are still issued at the reception desk, so I will leave the list of vehicles with you once it is updated. The volunteers should not need hard hats unless they enter the basement, and I will remind them to sign in. If any of the demo tools require a deposit, please tell me how much to reserve from the program budget. I also need to know whether the restroom can remain unlocked for the duration of the session, because the accessibility route makes a second stop inconvenient. If Tuesday remains impossible, Wednesday late afternoon is my next preference. I can bring the registration tablet and charge it beforehand. Please also confirm if the coffee urn must be collected from the storage shed the morning before the visit or the day before.
